description: Link-preview data for one or many public URLs: title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph and Twitter card fields, favicon, language, hreflang alternates, feed links and JSON-LD types. Respects robots.txt, refuses private addresses, no JavaScript rendering. Each page is one result; failed pages are listed with the reason and not charged. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

urls.description: Up to 20 public http(s) URLs; every page that returns metadata is one billable result.
